title: Tenant Environment Tiers Canonical Spec
purpose: Operationalizes ADR-0163. Declares the per-tenant test / staging / prod tier model, API-key prefix scheme, outbound-side-effect modes, destructive-op acknowledgment, and Cedar policy fragments.

test.outbound_description: outbound side effects (email, SMS, webhook, billing) are logged but not delivered to external systems

staging.outbound_description: outbound side effects fire to tenant-configured QA test recipients only
staging.prod_data_copy_to_staging_policy: forbidden without explicit ChangeSet approval gate (ADR-0110)

prod.outbound_description: outbound side effects fire to real recipients

tier_isolation_contract.cell_level_isolation: separate PostgreSQL schema (OR separate database within cell's PG cluster); RLS enforced
tier_isolation_contract.api_gateway_prefix_routing: ADR-0157 api-gateway reads API-key prefix and routes to env-tier-specific workload pool; sk_test_ never reaches prod schema
tier_isolation_contract.audit_chain_partition: per-tier subtree (audit-chain µservice partitions by (tenant_id, env_tier) per ADR-0162)
tier_isolation_contract.foundry_isolation: per-tier GPU/sandbox pool; test-tier sandboxes use smaller/cheaper models

destructive_op_acknowledgment.ui_flow: explicit confirmation dialog before sending header

workflow_studio_integration.promotion_ladder: test → staging → prod (parallel to ChangeSet promotion)
